Description: Sets the server name displayed in the server browser. Use underscores (_) instead of spaces!

Game.ini MapNameOverride. Accepts Ancestral_Plains, Ancestral_Plains_Canvas, DM_Caldera, DM_Caldera_Canvas, Forest_Island, Forest_Island_Canvas, IslaTitania, MainMenuScreenMap_MP, Rival_Shores, Rival_Shores_Canvas, Temporal_Drift, Test_Performance, BB_Test_Map (QA), or Volcano_Bay. Test maps, Volcano Bay, and Scorched Valley may lack major shrines.
Sets whether to display the actual map name in the server browser, or instead the Custom Display Map Name. This does not change the map that is loaded.
Sets a custom map name to display in the server browser, if Use Custom Display Map Name is selected under Display Map Name Mode
Sets the game mode for the server (command line and Game.ini GameMode)

Browser/rules label only. PvP marks a deathmatch server (no gameplay effect). PvE marks a genetics/nesting/chill server. PvPvE is the default. Chill servers often keep PvPvE because of event and PvE-mode oversights.
Sets the password required for players to join the server

Password passed on the server command line as AdminPassword. This is not Game.ini ServerAdminPassword. If this command-line password is set and you do not know it, in-game commands will not work. Use Server Admin Passwords on the Administration tab for the Game.ini key.
Game.ini ServerAdminPassword. Accepts multiple passwords separated by commas. Leave blank to omit the line. Separate from the command-line Admin Password field.
Sets the maximum number of players that can connect to the server at one time
If enabled, players can open the Discord invite from the in-game interface. Requires Discord Invite Code to be set.

Invite code only, not the full URL (the part after discord.gg/). AMP AutoMaps DiscordLink only when the key already exists. A file without DiscordLink= keeps it omitted unless you add the line in Game.ini.

Game.ini bRequireSteamGroupToJoin. The Steam group check is broken and currently prevents joining the server. Keep this false. If it is false you must omit Steam Group Name or the game treats the check as true.

Steam group unique name. The Steam group check is broken and currently prevents joining. AMP never AutoMaps SteamGroupName, so an empty SteamGroupName= line is never written. If you must set a group, paste SteamGroupName=YourGroup into Game.ini only while Require Steam Group To Join is true.
Game.ini SteamWorkshopFoliageSaveItemIDs. Comma-separated workshop item IDs. Empty skips the line.
Game.ini GameServerLoginToken for Steam workshop foliage downloads. Empty skips the line.
Game.ini bUpdateFoliageFilesFromWorkshop. If false, the server keeps local workshop foliage copies.
Seconds between automatic saves. The game clamps this to a minimum of 30 seconds.
Food drain rate. Easy is half, Normal is default, Hard is double, Expert is triple.
Water drain rate. Easy is half, Normal is default, Hard is double, Expert is triple.
How quickly water becomes dirty. Easy is half, Normal is default, Hard is double, Expert is triple.
Multiplier for foliage spawn/regrowth relative to the normal rate.
Length of a full 24-hour in-game day in seconds. Default 7200. Day is 62.4% of this value and night is 37.6%. Examples: 3600 is a 1 hour cycle, 962 is a 10 minute day and 6 minute night.
Total meat spawned over time. Range 0 to 8. Default 1.0.
Size versus number of carcasses, 0 to 2. 2.0 (default) is tiny frequent carcasses. 0 is large rare carcasses.
Default true disables Restless. Set false to enable Restless, which punishes 100% shelter outside of poor weather, including light storms.
Default true disables random abandoned eggs. Set false to enable them. Abandoned eggs are not recommended on mixpacking or small servers and may be tied to a mixpacking group-visibility bug.
Chance a carcass spawn generates an abandoned egg. 0 stops egg spawns; 1 always spawns eggs instead of carcasses.

Game.ini TunnelNetworkDespawnTime: seconds until a tunnel despawns if nobody has dug in it. Guide default is 1800 (30 minutes). The game default is 259200 (3 days). Standing on assets such as BurrowBoulder02_C can cause DoS-level log spam for both server and client, so keep this timer low. Values below the 15 second server tick can lag or destabilize the server.
If true, portals are disabled. Palaeophis can cause CPU leaks at times when using portals.
If true, world events can spawn. Keep false unless you want events. Event chat in Global can become spammy.
Minutes from when a world event spawns until it starts.
World event duration in minutes.
Minutes between world events.

WorldEventBuffsToNotUse values that are not one of the eight event toggles. One EVENT_ name per line. AMP writes WorldEventBuffsToNotUse= in front of each line. Empty skips the line so Game.ini does not get a trailing WorldEventBuffsToNotUse=.
UE units (centimeters) added to ocean height for high tide, low tide, and floods. Default 0. You will not see much difference until about 100. Negative values are allowed.
Default true disables the leaderboard. Set false to enable it (highest growth after creatures die or reset to 1.0).

Default true disables revenge-kill protection. Set false to stop players spawning a saved character within 750m of where they died, unless no other spawn is available. Should not apply to resurrection, reincarnation, or fresh spawns.
Default true disables UseRandomName. Set false to allow the command, which is similar to UseIncognito with a randomized name.
SaveSystem bDisableCharacterDeath. If true, Free Roam deaths auto-resurrect with no growth penalty.
If false, fires are disabled. If true, dry wildfires, lava-induced fires, and lightning-induced fires can spawn. Lava-induced fires are bugged.
Keeps flooding from getting too high. Disable to allow superfloods.
How high flood surge goes. 0 disables flooding. Values above 1 multiply flood height.
Enables tornado spawning during high-wind storms.
Enables stress caused by severe weather.
How fast the weather system runs. Higher is faster storms; lower is drawn-out weather.
How severe weather is. Higher is more extreme; lower is calmer.
How often storms spawn. Lower means storms back-to-back; higher means longer gaps.
Relative chance of rain. 0 disables this weather type.
Relative chance of fog. 0 disables this weather type.
Relative chance of overcast. 0 disables this weather type.
Relative chance of dry lightning. 0 disables this weather type.
Default true disables all AI spawning (less RAM). Set false to enable AI unless a species is disabled below. Aquatic AI, especially Malawania, use the most server resources.
Multiplies how often the AI respawn tick happens. Lower values respawn AI more frequently.
Multiplies how many AI may be active in each spawn region. Higher values allow more AI at cap.

Sends chat activity to Discord when the webhook ID is set.
Discord webhook path only (id/token after discord.com/api/webhooks/), not the full URL. AMP writes the value in quotes. Leave blank to omit the line.
Optional image URL used as the chat webhook avatar.
Format string. [:x01] is a backtick; \n is a newline. Placeholders include {PlayerInfo}, {ChatMode}, {msg}.
Sends join/leave reports to Discord.
Discord webhook path only (id/token after discord.com/api/webhooks/), not the full URL. AMP writes the value in quotes. Leave blank to omit the line.
Optional image URL used as the login webhook avatar.
Join format. Placeholders include {PlayerInfo} and {Server}.
Leave format. Placeholders include {PlayerInfo}, {Server}, {Hours}, {Minutes}.
DefaultValue: [:x01]<{PlayerInfo}>[:x01] disconnected from {Server} with a total session time of {Hours}h {Minutes}m.
